Afterword & Colophon

后记与版本说明

About the Contributors关于撰稿人

The essays in this book were written by 97 practicing data engineers, architects, engineering managers, and researchers from companies such as Netflix, Spotify, Netflix, Twitter, Google, Amazon, Databricks, Confluent, Monte Carlo, and many startups. The original book includes a full biography for each author; this bilingual edition omits those biographies to focus on the technical content.

本书文章由 97 位一线数据工程师、架构师、工程经理和研究人员撰写，来自 Netflix、Spotify、Twitter、Google、Amazon、Databricks、Confluent、Monte Carlo 以及众多初创公司。原书为每位作者提供了完整小传；本双语版略去这些小传，聚焦技术内容。

Colophon版本说明

This bilingual HTML edition is generated from the original PDF. Each chapter is a single offline HTML file: all images are embedded as base64 data URIs, no network access is required to read them. Use the bottom-right 🌐 button to switch between English-only, Chinese-only, and bilingual (both) modes; your preference is remembered between pages.

本双语 HTML 版从原 PDF 生成。每章是一个独立的离线 HTML 文件：所有图片以 base64 data URI 内嵌，阅读时无需联网。用右下角 🌐 按钮在仅英文、仅中文、中英对照三种模式间切换；偏好会在页面间记忆。

Original title: 97 Things Every Data Engineer Should Know, edited by Tobias Macey (O'Reilly, 2021). For the official edition, please purchase the book from O'Reilly or your favorite bookseller.

原书名：97 Things Every Data Engineer Should Know，Tobias Macey 编（O'Reilly，2021）。正式版请通过 O'Reilly 或你喜欢的书店购买。
